title: Poora sheher jaanta hai
caption:
Sunita madam ko sab jaante hain. Isliye woh kuch keh nahi paatin. Phir roz ek naya naam mila. 👇
Roz naya naam, koi pehchaan nahi: Waypoint, link in bio. 18+
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a small-town teacher everyone knows, who cannot say anything as herself, until she finds a place where she gets a fresh name every day. Waypoint is free on Google Play, for adults 18 and over.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Sunita: Sunita is a 34-year-old school teacher in a small Indian town, with hair in a neat plait, a teal cotton saree, a thin gold chain and a gentle composed face.
cast.fox: The fox mascot is a friendly small orange fox with big kind eyes and a teal scarf, standing on two legs like a storybook character.

scenes.vo: सुनीता मैडम को, पूरा शहर जानता है।
scenes.sub: Sunita madam ko, poora sheher jaanta hai.
scenes.art: Sunita in a teal saree walks down a small-town market street in the morning, shopkeepers and parents greeting her with folded hands and smiles from every side, a school bag on her shoulder.

scenes.vo: सब्ज़ी वाला, पड़ोसी, बच्चों के माता-पिता।
scenes.sub: Sabzi wala, padosi, bachchon ke maata-pita.
scenes.art: Three small warm pictures side by side like a storybook strip: a vegetable seller waving, a neighbour peering over a balcony, parents at a school gate, all looking towards the viewer.

scenes.vo: इसलिए वो कभी कुछ नहीं कहती। मैडम जो हैं।
scenes.sub: Isliye woh kabhi kuch nahi kehtin. Madam jo hain.
scenes.art: Sunita stands at the blackboard in a classroom smiling calmly at her students, but a faint grey shadow version of her behind her holds a hand over its own mouth.

scenes.vo: घर आकर भी, दीवारों के कान होते हैं।
scenes.sub: Ghar aakar bhi, deewaron ke kaan hote hain.
scenes.art: Sunita sits alone at her dining table at night with a cup of tea, through the open window the lit windows of neighbours' houses are very close, a curtain half drawn.

scenes.vo: एक सच, जो वो किसी से नहीं कह सकती।
scenes.sub: Ek sach, jo woh kisi se nahi keh saktin.
scenes.art: Close view of Sunita's face in lamplight, eyes lowered, holding a closed diary against her chest, quiet and heavy.

scenes.vo: फिर उसे एक जगह मिली। जहाँ रोज़ नया नाम मिलता है।
scenes.sub: Phir use ek jagah mili. Jahan roz naya naam milta hai.

scenes.vo: न मैडम, न पड़ोसन, न किसी की बेटी।
scenes.sub: Na madam, na padosan, na kisi ki beti.
scenes.art: Sunita in a teal saree with a neat plait sits on her bed at night holding her phone, her face relaxed and free for the first time, a small blue bird drawn glowing softly above the phone, a friendly small orange fox with a teal scarf sitting beside her on the bed.

scenes.vo: और उसने लिखा, जो सालों से अंदर था।
scenes.sub: Aur usne likha, jo saalon se andar tha.

scenes.vo: कल, एक नया नाम होगा। और वो फिर भी वही रहेगी।
scenes.sub: Kal, ek naya naam hoga. Aur woh phir bhi wahi rahegi.
scenes.art: Sunita walking to school the next morning in her teal saree with a light step and a private smile, sunlight on the street, the fox mascot peeking from behind a tree.

scenes.vo: अगर आज आपका कोई नाम न होता, तो आप क्या कहते?
scenes.sub: Agar aaj aapka koi naam na hota, to aap kya kehte?
